target_profile.system_boundary: Captured Go Raft library. Protocol state machine and Ready machinery are in repository; actual network, durable backend and application are embedding responsibilities.
protocol_contexts: One raft group per RawNode/Node; local term/role, replicated log and active voter configuration.
external_interfaces: Node/RawNode Step, Tick, Ready, Advance and ApplyConfChange; Storage
ownership: Node serializes protocol activity in run; RawNode is thread-unsafe and requires caller serialization.
Durable storage, transport delivery and actual state-machine application remain embedding work; the library owns response construction and progress accounting.

activities.purpose: Qualified support for decision formation and legal advancement
activities.realization_summary: Leader proposal replication and current-term quorum commit; follower log matching.

activities.purpose: Context validity and acquisition, transfer or loss of authority
activities.realization_summary: Term and role transitions reset local support but preserve history.
Applied configuration replaces voter quorum and participant eligibility; construction not yet traced.

activities.purpose: History, persistence and reconstruction of support
activities.realization_summary: Ready and storage responses mediate durable history and support publication.

activities.purpose: Recovery and resynchronization of eligible participation
activities.realization_summary: Snapshot/restart reconstruct eligible state; append rejection and heartbeat probes recover replication.
Caller consumes committed entries in order, separately installs configuration and reports application progress.

activities.purpose: Client contracts, invocation intervals and observed completion
activities.realization_summary: ReadIndex requests carry caller correlation context and may be silently lost; retries belong to caller.

behaviors.protocol_context: Current leader term and active progress tracker
implementation_guards: Reject proposals during transfer or when local progress is absent; serialize configuration proposals against pendingConfIndex and joint state.
Ignore messages from senders without progress; Step filters obsolete terms.
writes: Append entries with current term and contiguous indexes.
Update peer Match and invoke maybeCommit against the active voter quorum and current-term log entry.
external_effects: Broadcast appends after proposal or commit advancement.
Only the successful MsgAppResp commit-advancement branch invokes releasePendingReadIndexMessages.
async_boundaries: Local self acknowledgement is queued until append completion; remote acknowledgements depend on the sender durability contract.

behaviors.protocol_context: Local term, role, leader and vote
behaviors.trigger: Campaign, election result, higher-term traffic or leadership loss
implementation_guards: hup requires local voter eligibility and no configuration entry in (raftLog.applied, raftLog.committed].
Vote responses must match candidacy type; voter sets determine quorum and duplicate votes do not overwrite earlier votes.
writes: reset clears votes, peer progress, transfer state and readOnly tracker, while retaining the log and commit index.
Campaign increments term and records self vote; becoming leader resets progress and appends a current-term empty entry.
external_effects: A winning pre-election starts a real election; a winning real election becomes leader and broadcasts appends.
Transfer catches up a voter and sends TimeoutNow; ticks cancel overdue transfer and optionally check quorum.
important_branches: Pre-candidate transition does not increment term or reset the full state.
Higher-term pre-votes and granted pre-vote responses have special handling.
Old storage append responses cannot stabilize entries but may complete a committed snapshot.
Timed transfer abort only clears leadTransferee; it does not itself invoke application completion or propose leave-joint.
unknowns: Whether allowed early Advance may move the campaign scan lower bound past a configuration not yet installed by ApplyConfChange.

behaviors.trigger: Caller applies ConfChange or snapshot restores ConfState
writes: Replace active configuration/progress and update learner status.
Changer copies configuration, limits simple changes to one voter, preserves outgoing voters during joint changes, and on leave removes obsolete progress and activates staged learners.
external_effects: Leader may recompute commit and broadcast; otherwise probes peers.
Removed or demoted leader steps down when stepDownOnRemoval is enabled.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Reinterprets acknowledgement quorum under the new voter sets and may advance commit.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Changes promotability and may remove current leader authority.

unknowns: Does the application-overlap permission include deferring ApplyConfChange beyond Advance?

behaviors.protocol_context: Ready batches, synchronous or asynchronous persistence
behaviors.trigger: Ready accepted and completed by caller or storage response
writes: acceptReady records previous HardState and marks unstable/applying work in progress.
Synchronous acceptReady saves a MsgStorageApplyResp for the committed entries; Advance steps it even though its Ready argument is ignored.
external_effects: Synchronous Ready exposes durable-dependent remote replies; self replies are held for Advance.
Asynchronous Ready emits append/apply work carrying completion responses.
async_boundaries: Caller must persist entries before sending synchronous Ready.Messages according to the Ready contract.
Async local messages must be reliable and ordered per storage target, with durable append completion before responses.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Controls when append and vote support can be published.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Persists term/vote and filters stale completion through Step.

unknowns: Package usage text permits current-batch send/persist overlap while Ready requires persistence first; applicability needs resolution.

behaviors.execution_owner: raft application completion handler and embedding application
behaviors.protocol_context: Committed log prefix handed out in Ready
behaviors.trigger: MsgStorageApplyResp, including the response saved for synchronous Advance
writes: Calls raft.appliedTo then raftLog.appliedTo; applied is monotonic, bounded by committed, and releases application byte accounting.
external_effects: appliedTo can propose automatic leave-joint when leader and applied reaches pendingConfIndex; failure during transfer is logged and retry is tied to later appliedTo.

cross_activity_effects.A2: The reported applied index bounds the scan guarding campaigning.
cross_activity_effects.A4: Application separately calls ApplyConfChange to install voter changes; appliedTo can trigger auto-leave.

unknowns: Whether early Advance permission requires configuration installation first.

implementation_guards: Ignore snapshots at or below committed; require follower role and recipient membership.
A matching snapshot entry only fast-forwards commit; full restoration resets log and reconstructs voter state.
writes: newRaft restores configuration and HardState, accepts Config.Applied if supplied, and starts follower.
Snapshot completion calls appliedSnap/appliedTo; full restoration rebuilds progress from snapshot ConfState.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Restored committed history cannot be replaced by older snapshots.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Pending snapshots prevent promotion; new instances start followers.
cross_activity_effects.A4: Full snapshot restoration reconstructs voter eligibility.

behaviors.execution_owner: Leader read tracking and follower ReadIndex response handler
behaviors.protocol_context: ReadOnlySafe heartbeat quorum or configured lease mode
behaviors.trigger: ReadIndex, first current-term commit on MsgAppResp, heartbeat acknowledgements
implementation_guards: Non-singleton leader defers reads until a current-term entry is committed.
Safe reads collect context-matched acknowledgements and require active voter quorum.
writes: readOnly maps unique request context to committed index, original request and acknowledgements.
Acknowledging a queued context advances the prefix of pending safe reads.
external_effects: Returns ReadStates locally or MsgReadIndexResp remotely; caller correlates RequestCtx and waits for application.
important_branches: reset replaces readOnly but does not clear the separate pendingReadIndexMessages slice.
Singleton reads return committed index immediately.
Only append-response-driven commit advancement calls releasePendingReadIndexMessages; configuration-driven commit does not.
unknowns: Reachability of deferred reads across configuration-driven first current-term commit remains conditional on application/campaign ordering.

behaviors.protocol_context: Peer log recovery under current leader
behaviors.trigger: Append rejection, heartbeat response, unreachable/snapshot status and replication sending
writes: Rejected appends lower Next via conflict hints; success frees inflights and resumes replication.
Missing predecessor or entries requests a snapshot; snapshot sending pauses progress.
external_effects: Heartbeat responses allow empty append probes even with full inflights; unavailable snapshot waits for a later retry.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Restores paths for obtaining eligible durable support.

behaviors.protocol_context: Serialized read of the active membership configuration
behaviors.trigger: Caller requests current group Status or clones a Config
reads: Active voter/learner sets and AutoLeave state are represented in tracker.Config.
writes: Clone deep-copies voter and learner maps into a new Config literal, omitting AutoLeave.
external_effects: Status returns the cloned Config to its caller; live configuration is not mutated.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Reports the quorum configuration used for decision formation.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Reports the configuration context that controls participant eligibility.

facts.meaning: The local raft log records that its application progress has advanced through index i; this accounting marker alone does not encode which ApplyConfChange calls have executed.
facts.validity_context: Current local instance and committed log prefix; monotonically advanced completion/recovery accounting. The synchronous early-Advance contract may report progress before all external application finishes.
facts.durability: Volatile; caller reconstructs Config.Applied and snapshot/storage state on restart.
facts.recovery: Config.Applied initializes the marker; snapshot completion may advance it. Ordinary application responses advance it through the last returned entry.
unknowns: Whether configuration installation is independently required before an early Advance that advances this marker.

facts.meaning: The active configuration contains outgoing and incoming voter sets and marks automatic departure from joint state as assigned to Raft; it does not assert that a leave entry has been proposed.

identity.configuration: active incoming and outgoing voter sets

facts.validity_context: Active joint configuration after ApplyConfChange or ConfState restoration, until leave-joint or replacement by restored configuration.
facts.durability: In-memory configuration, reconstructible from caller-persisted ConfState and committed configuration entries.
facts.recovery: confchange.Restore reconstructs AutoLeave and voter sets from ConfState.

surfaces.reason: Commit advancement broadcasts but does not call releasePendingReadIndexMessages, unlike MsgAppResp. Legal triggering history and continuation obligation remain unresolved.
Conflicting persistence-before-send guidance; do not choose the weaker contract to create a witness.
Documented application overlap may separate reported progress from installed membership; legality of deferring ApplyConfChange is the immediate discriminator.

Explicit implicit-transition contract assigns leave proposal to Raft. appliedTo attempts it, proposal rejects during transfer, and timeout abort has no visible retry; investigate whether future protocol work necessarily supplies another application completion.
Current configuration copy omits AutoLeave. Investigate fidelity as a separate local contract, not live-state corruption.

formation.explanation: A leader assigns entry term/index, replicates and counts Match acknowledgements through active voter quorums. Current-term matching gates commit advancement. Followers match the preceding entry and reject committed-prefix conflicts; Ready exposes committed work to the caller. Node serializes Step/Tick/configuration work; RawNode instead requires caller serialization. Duplicate votes are ignored, learners are excluded from tally counts, and active joint voter sets decide elections and commits. Rejections use log conflict hints; heartbeat responses unpause replication, with snapshots used when compacted history is unavailable. Application observes ordered committed entries and independently installs configurations.

context.explanation: Campaign and term handling acquire or lose leader authority. Real candidacy increments term; reset discards peer support and readOnly tracking. A new leader retains history, appends an empty current-term entry and conservatively delays configuration proposals until prior history is applied. Campaign admission scans for unapplied committed configuration entries and requires voter eligibility with no pending snapshot. A pre-vote victory starts a real campaign, and a vote victory becomes leader. Lease/check-quorum policy can suppress disruption; transfer catches up a voter before TimeoutNow, with timed abort. Old-term network replies are filtered before role dispatch; same-term leader traffic makes candidates followers. Restart reconstructs configuration/history and starts follower.

connection.explanation: Progress support is leader-context local, while committed history survives reset. Configuration application changes quorum interpretation and can itself advance commit. Persistence-qualified replies connect durable history to election and append support; old-term storage completion cannot discard potentially overwritten unstable entries. Joint configuration retains both voter sets until leave-joint; quorum decisions require both majorities. Committed snapshots are term-independent but obsolete snapshots are rejected. Ready completion advances a local applied marker consumed by campaign admission, while ApplyConfChange separately installs membership. Safe-read acknowledgements are cleared by reset, whereas pre-current-term pending reads survive in a separate slice; later append-driven first commit releases them under the then-current context. ReadIndex callers must tolerate loss and retry.

open_details: Early Advance versus configuration installation and campaign admission.
Configuration-driven pending-read release is conditional on legal reachability; ReadIndex has caller-owned retries.
Conflicting synchronous persistence/send guidance remains unresolved.
Automatic joint exit is retried on later application completion; transfer timeout itself only clears the transferee, so later application is a distinct continuation premise.
Status configuration copy omits AutoLeave; public copy fidelity is a separate question from automatic-exit continuation.
core_overview.rationale: Representative formation and authority paths now include voter construction, election aggregation, dispatch, durable completion, application, snapshot/restart and old pending work. Local ordering questions remain explicit.
